SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksDefeat.en: Good match!\nAh, I feel young again!
SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksDefeat.fr: Beau combat !\nAh, je me sens jeune à nouveau !

SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksIntro.en: Competing against the young keeps\nme youthful.

SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksPostBattle.en: Fifteen years ago, I would\nhave won!
SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksPostBattle.fr: Il y a quinze ans, j'aurais gagné !

SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DaleIntro.en: Check out what I fished up!

SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DalePostBattle.en: Party?\pThe cruise ship's party should be\nover by now.
SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DalePostBattle.fr: La fête ?\pLa fête de la croisière doit être\nfinie à cette heure.
